meaning: Identity card. The mandatory national ID for residents — its 9-digit number identifies you to every government office.
Case/file number. Always quote this number when calling or writing about a specific letter or matter.
National Insurance Institute. Israel's social-security agency, handles pensions, unemployment, maternity, disability and more.
Income Tax (Authority). The Israel Tax Authority — assesses and collects personal and corporate income tax.
Payment demand. An official request to pay an outstanding amount by a stated date.
Final deadline. The last date for the action specified in a document; consequences of missing it depend on the procedure.
Appeal or challenge to a decision. Check the precise procedure and filing deadline on your own notice; objection (השגה) and appeal (ערעור) may be different stages.
usageNote: Keep a copy and submission confirmation. Check the official procedure and deadline for your specific decision.

meaning: Confirmation or approval. A document or letter that confirms a status, eligibility, or completed action.
Explanatory note. The supplementary page attached to a letter that explains the figures or decisions on the main page.
Clause or section. Refers to a numbered paragraph of a law or document.
Validity. The period during which a document, permit, or approval is in force.
Exemption. Relief from an obligation — most commonly tax, but also fees or service requirements.
Enforcement. A system for enforcing judgments and collecting debts; available measures depend on the case and law.
usageNote: Check the sender, case number and response procedure; seek qualified help where needed.

meaning: Interest. Added to overdue amounts; can also refer to interest you owe or are owed under a law.
Regulation. A binding rule issued under the authority of a law. Often cited by number (e.g. "Takana 2(a)").
Debt. A sum the authority says you still owe, often with interest or linkage added until it is paid.
Instalment plan. An approved schedule that lets you pay a debt over several payments instead of all at once.
Document completion. A request to submit missing proofs before an office can finish processing your case.
Tax refund. Money returned after the Tax Authority determines you paid more than you owed.
Appointment booking. A reservation for a branch visit, often required before biometric or document services.
